prerequisites: Target net11.0 and set LangVersion to 15.0; use framework System.Text.Json and the supplied metadata contexts.
constraints: Default union storage has no active case; handle null explicitly.

Structural classification excludes nested unions, polymorphic cases and ReferenceHandler.Preserve.

selectionNotes: Object cases need an unambiguous classifier; structural matching excludes nested unions, polymorphic cases and ReferenceHandler.Preserve.
